focus: North, Northwest, West, and South Side truck-rental desks inside Chicago, plus labor-only crews with Chicago offices and one clearly labeled Evanston office
intro: This first Chicago page covers official Penske and Budget truck-rental locations whose own location pages list a Chicago address, plus labor-only movers whose own sites publish an address and hours (two Chicago offices and one clearly labeled Evanston office that markets labor-only service in Chicago). It is not a complete citywide inventory, and it does not report live truck counts. One-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page mentions those services. If a day’s hours were missing, they are marked “Not published,” not guessed as closed. If you already have a truck or container, use the labor-only filter or the HireAHelper box further down the page.

listings.name: Penske Truck Rental at Cub's Park Service

hours.notes: Hours from the official Penske location page. The page marks after-hours key drop as open and includes a one-way rental phone line. The printed drop-off instruction on that page appears to be generic (it mentions 1st Avenue at this and other locations); confirm the drop location with the branch.

listings.offersNotes: The official page includes a “Reserve a Truck” path and a “Looking for a one-way rental?” prompt. Company-wide copy on the same page mentions unlimited mileage with one-way trips. Truck sizes on the lot are not listed as a fixed inventory here.
listings.visitNotes: Published as closed Sunday; Saturday closes at 2:00 PM. Do not treat the reservation page as live inventory.

listings.name: Fallen Movers
listings.area: Chicago · West Congress Parkway (Near West Side)

hours.notes: Hours from the official moving-labor page, which lists Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–8:00 PM and Sunday closed.

offers: PODS and storage container loading and unloading
listings.offersNotes: The official page describes Fallen Movers as a labor-only moving company serving Chicago, with loading and unloading for rental trucks, PODS, and storage containers, plus in-home furniture moving.
listings.visitNotes: Published as closed Sunday. Confirm crew availability for your date.

listings.name: Forrester Moving — Load Help
listings.address: 159 N Sangamon St, Suite 200, Chicago, IL 60607

hours.notes: Office hours from the official load-help and contact pages, which list Monday–Saturday 7am–7pm. Sunday is not published.

offers: PODS, ABF, and shipping container loading
listings.offersNotes: The official load-help page says loading and unloading is offered on a labor-only basis across Chicago: you handle the rental, POD, or container and the crew does the lifting. Its FAQ says the crew does not drive the rental truck or shuttle the POD.
listings.visitNotes: The published hours are office hours; confirm crew availability for your date.
listings.feeNotes: The load-help page shows hourly rates starting from $150/hr for a two-mover crew with a two-hour minimum, as listed on 2026-11-18. The same pricing block also mentions a truck being built into the price, so confirm the labor-only rate when you request a quote.

listings.name: ACM Movers (Evanston office)
listings.area: Evanston · West Howard Street (on the Chicago city line; clearly labeled suburban office)

hours.notes: Business hours from the official Chicago labor-only page: Monday 8:00AM–8:30PM, Tuesday–Friday 8:00AM–8:00PM, Saturday 9:00AM–6:00PM, Sunday 9:00AM–4:00PM. The same page also lists an Arlington Heights address (3361 N Ridge Ave).

offers: PODS and U-Pack container loading and unloading
listings.offersNotes: The official page says labor-only moving means you provide the transportation and ACM Movers provides the crew. It lists loading U-Haul, Penske, and Budget trucks, PODS and U-Pack containers, ABF trailers, and storage units.
listings.visitNotes: This office is in Evanston, not inside Chicago city limits; the page markets labor-only service in Chicago. Confirm crew availability for your date.
